## Purpose

Describe the change and the part of the pipeline it affects.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests and lint were run, or the reason they could not run is stated.
- [ ] Data, label, window, model or metric changes include their comparability impact.
- [ ] Relevant architecture, data and reproducibility docs were updated.
- [ ] New metrics identify subject IDs, source checksums, seed, parameters and device.
- [ ] No raw participant data or trained checkpoints were added unintentionally.

## Reproduction

Give the exact command and output artifact path when applicable. Link to aggregate results only if they are approved for sharing.
